description: Alaska Coastal Profile Tool is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Alaska Department of Natural Resources, Division of Geological & Geophysical Surveys; USFWS Coastal Impact Assistance Program; Alaska Ocean Observing System. This interactive map provides access to beach elevation profile measurements collected throughout Alaska since the 1960s. Exploring profile measurements collected by the Alaska Division of Geological & Geophysical Surveys and others as time-series plots and location-based images can reveal changes in the shore-facing environment. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
